Name: Stardew Valley Dual Screen Mod
Author: Profmags (adapted for Stardual Valley by breepear)
Description: Feeds the Stardual Valley lower-screen app: your day, an overview of things to do, map, relationships, farm, journal, bundles, calendar and settings. Works with Stardew Valley on Android (SMAPI Launcher) and on PC (Cinderbox).
